words.trans: n. 一大群人、人群；joined the throng of pedestrians 汇入行人的人群
examples: They joined the throng of pedestrians on the high street.

words.trans: v. 仔细查看、审视
examples: She scrutinised the map, frowning.

words.trans: v. 步履沉重地走、费力跋涉
examples: They trudged up the hill, legs heavy as lead.

words.trans: adv. 慢吞吞地、行动迟缓地
examples: The traffic crawled sluggishly through the village.

words.trans: n.（英式）婴儿手推车
examples: A woman pushed a pram full of shopping bags.

words.trans: adj. 挂满装饰物的；balloon-festooned pram 挂满气球的婴儿车
examples: A balloon-festooned pram bobbed along behind its owner.

words.trans: adv. 嗓音沙哑地、嘶哑地
examples: 'Come back,' he called hoarsely after them.

words.trans: v.（slink 过去式）偷偷摸摸走、潜行、畏缩蹲下；slunk down on his haunches 蹲伏下来
examples: The dog slunk down on his haunches under the table.

words.trans: n.（动物的）腰腿、臀部；on one’s haunches 蹲坐
examples: The wolf crouched on its haunches, ready to spring.

words.trans: 一片熙攘模糊的游客人影
examples: Beyond the window was a blur of tourists and flashing cameras.

words.trans: （人群）漫无目的地四处转悠、闲逛走动
examples: Crowds milled around outside the station, unsure where to go.

words.word: with their heads in maps and leaflets
words.trans: 脑袋埋下去，低头看地图/宣传单
examples: The visitors shuffled past with their heads in maps and leaflets.

words.trans: adj. 油腻的、油滑谄媚的；unctuous body spray 味道浓烈刺鼻的香体喷雾
examples: He smelt of an unctuous body spray that made her cough.

words.trans: n. 沾沾自喜、得意洋洋
examples: A smile of pure smugness spread across his face.

words.trans: v. 牢牢安放、重重搁置（动词引申义，非“种植”）；plant one’s feet 双脚稳稳扎在地上、立定站好，带刻意、坚决的姿态
examples: She planted her feet and refused to move another step.

words.trans: adv. 茫然地、面无表情地、眼神空洞地
examples: He stared blankly at the screen, not understanding a word.

words.trans: 我超级想吃个汉堡。习语，字面“屠杀”，实际口语表示非常想吃
examples: 'I could slaughter a burger,' he groaned, starving.

words.trans: v. 重步踩踏、步履沉重地行走；侧重脚步很重、咚咚踩地，不一定累，强调脚步声沉重
examples: Boots tramped noisily across the wooden floor above them.

words.trans: 走在前面把控队伍的快慢，其他人跟着他的脚步
examples: The tall guide set the pace, and the rest struggled to keep up.

words.trans: v. 悠闲漫步、闲逛
examples: He sauntered along the front as if he had nowhere to be.

words.trans: n. 小丑；口语指蠢货、笨蛋；those clowns 这帮蠢货
examples: Those clowns never bother to lock the gate.

words.trans: n.（复数口语）胆量、勇气；haven’t got the guts 没有胆量
examples: She hadn't got the guts to tell her parents the truth.

words.trans: n. 寒鸦
examples: A jackdaw landed on the wall, cocking its grey head.

words.trans: v. 低声嘟囔、喃喃自语
examples: He muttered something under his breath about fools.

words.trans: 真相终将大白。固定谚语，out 此处是动词含义“显露出来”，不要按字面“真相会出去”理解
examples: You can lie for now, but the truth will out in the end.

words.trans: adj.（树木）落叶的
examples: In autumn the deciduous trees shed every leaf.

words.trans: n. 地衣
examples: Grey-green lichen spread across the old gravestone.

words.trans: n. 胡须；（植物）穗状须毛；lichen-bearded branches 垂挂着地衣的树枝
examples: The lichen-bearded branches hung low over the path.

words.trans: adj.（人、树木）干枯皱缩的、苍老干瘪的
examples: A wizened old face looked out from under the hood.

words.trans: n. 花楸树（别名 rowan）；欧洲山林常见落叶乔木，不是“山上的灰烬”
examples: The bright berries of the mountain ashes blazed red.

words.trans: n.（复数）（岩石）露出地面的岩层、露头
examples: Pale outcrops of limestone broke through the heather.

words.trans: n. 石灰岩、石灰石
examples: The stream ran white with dissolved limestone.

words.trans: 铺着树皮碎块的林间小径
examples: Their boots made no sound on the soft bark-chip path.

words.trans: n. 落叶松（复数）
examples: Golden larches glowed against the dark pines.

words.trans: 欧洲赤松、苏格兰松
examples: The old Scots pines twisted into strange shapes in the wind.

words.trans: n. 树脂；resin-scented 散发树脂香气的
examples: The air was thick and resin-scented, warm from the sun.

words.trans: adj. 怪异诡异的、令人毛骨悚然的
examples: An eerie silence fell over the whole forest.

words.trans: 鸟瞰、俯瞰、全局视角。习语，字面“鸟儿眼睛的视角”，实际指居高临下的观察视角
examples: From the cliff top we got a bird's-eye view of the valley.

words.trans: 储备物资、采购补给；We need to stock up on food before hiking. 徒步前我们要储备食物
examples: We need to stock up on supplies before the snow closes the pass.

words.trans: 在……旁边徘徊、逗留
examples: A hawk hovered by the treetops, searching for prey.

words.trans: （动物）从喉咙深处发出低吼
examples: The dog growled deep in his throat at the stranger.

words.word: bang one's hand on one's forehead
words.trans: 用手猛拍额头（夸张假装恍然大悟/懊恼的动作）
examples: He banged his hand on his forehead at his own stupidity.

words.word: keep the tremor out of one's voice
words.trans: 不让自己声音发抖，努力稳住声调
examples: She asked the question calmly, keeping the tremor out of her voice.

words.trans: 把话说白、明明白白讲出来；Do I have to spell it out for you? 非要我跟你说得明明白白吗
examples: Do I have to spell it out for you? The answer is no.

words.trans: 泄露（秘密）、暴露；give away how important it was 暴露它有多重要
examples: His trembling hands gave away how nervous he was.

words.word: something inside her was about to snap
words.trans: 她内心快要绷不住了、快要爆发。snap 这里不是“咔嚓剪断实物”，指情绪、精神绷断失控
examples: The pressure built until something inside her was about to snap.

words.trans: 比出手枪手势（手指模仿手枪指着别人）
examples: He made pistol fingers and pointed them jokingly at his friend.

words.trans: 认真看待某人的威胁
examples: Nobody seemed to take his threat seriously.

words.trans: 蹦蹦跳跳跑到前面
examples: The excited children bounded ahead down the trail.

words.trans: 翻腾白沫如同大锅一般（形容湍急翻涌的水流，cauldron 本义大锅）
examples: The river boiled and churned into foaming white cauldrons.

words.trans: v. 长途艰难跋涉、徒步远行
examples: They trekked for hours across the open moor.

words.trans: v.（物体）滑行、滑翔，不靠动力顺势飘行
examples: The cyclist coasted downhill, legs still, no pedalling.

words.trans: v. 大步流星地走、阔步前行
examples: He strode into the room like he owned the place.

words.trans: n. 法兰绒、法兰绒布料
examples: She wore an old checked flannel shirt to keep warm.

words.trans: 被……取代、让位给；the ancient deciduous trees surrendered to larches 古老落叶乔木渐渐被落叶松取代
examples: The old deciduous woods gradually surrendered to young larches.

words.trans: 成堆堆积的干枯松针
examples: Their boots sank into deep drifts of dry needles.

words.trans: 一直向上长直到抵达……；树木枝干不断向上伸展
examples: Tall trunks stretch up to a distant green canopy.

words.trans: 挡住、隔绝在外，把光和声阻隔住
examples: The thick branches seemed to shut out light and sound.

words.trans: v. 困住、截留，流体/空气无法向外逃逸；不一定是抓活物，可用于气体、空气
examples: The valley walls trapped the cold air all night.

words.trans: 一堆堆、一片片，随风堆积而成的一团团。核心：经风飘落堆积的东西，最经典原义 drifts of snow 一堆积雪，可引申用于落叶、花瓣、松针等轻质物料
examples: Drifts of fallen leaves lined the edges of the road.

words.trans: n. 指南针、罗盘、圆规
examples: She checked the compass to make sure they headed north.

words.trans: v.（手脚并用）攀爬、匍匐翻越，跌跌撞撞地艰难行进
examples: They scrambled up the loose rocks on all fours.

words.trans: 突然冲到开阔地带；spilt（spill 过去式）本意泼洒，这里描写人一下子从树林冲出来
examples: The path suddenly spilled out into the open fell.

words.trans: 在微风中瑟瑟晃动（描写树梢，不是人发抖）
examples: The slender saplings shivered in the cold breeze.
